ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A centralized, low-intensity contiguous anchor-shaped region occupies the medial fluke, flanked by high-intensity lateral regions on both lobes; these white zones exhibit high-frequency low-intensity mottling and circular pixel clusters towards the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 55 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the upper distal margins of both lobes, contrasted against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the outer distal margins, terminating in sharp, upward-sloping tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings and dark focal points) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, densely concentrated on the lateral tips and sporadically distributed across the central dark pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) are visible on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe and medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters and associated tissue irregularities are present on the extreme lateral edges and trailing tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast 'spatter' or speckled transition zone at the interface of the dark central pigment and the white lateral patches, creating a unique stochastic pixel distribution.
